description: Multi-Sheet Consolidation, Transform & Convert, Alert Semaphores for SAC Planning

setExistingDataInfo.description: Passes current Table_1 row values to the widget for client-side accumulation in Append mode

dataReady.description: Fired after a successful DIS upload and when the user clicks Refresh SAC Table. Connect to Table_1.getDataSource().refreshData() in the SAC story.

publishRequested.description: Fired when the user clicks Publish Version. Connect to your planning model publish action in the SAC story. Detail: { modelId, version, date }.
